_comment: Git development-stage presentation sketch for sample B, additive to schema v0. This multi-author sketch describes only the student's Git stages after author-scope filtering: first-parent ordering, merge anchors, side-commit and replay deduplication, collaboration boundaries, and explicit history truncation. It is not the trace message/turn/episode aggregation schema and does not assert trace-to-commit causation.
schema_note: Draft target for the Git stage layer. Additive to schema v0; no existing fields changed. Names may change before implementation. Trace work segments remain a separate narrative-presentation concern.

author_scope.author: Liushenwuzhu-Alpaca
author_scope.excluded: commits by other contributors are filtered at parse time, not merely hidden at render time
author_scope.boundary_rule: collaboration boundaries are stated as scope notes ('implemented by collaborators, out of scope'); no per-commit attribution and no contribution ranking in output
